tools.name: ping
tools.description: Free health check. Does not spend USDC.

tools.name: wallet_profile
tools.description: Holdings valued in USD, a short plain-language summary, windowed realized and unrealized PnL, win rate, and evidence-backed labels such as active memecoin trader. Costs $0.01 USDC.

tools.name: token_trending
tools.description: Trending Solana tokens with liquidity, 24h volume, pair age, and a short summary. Each token includes holder concentration (top-10 share), mint and freeze authority, LP lock or burn status, and sniper or bundle share of early supply. Risky results are plain-English risk flags. Thin, new, and wash-li

tools.name: wallet_funding
tools.description: Find a wallet's first SOL funder, flag wallets that share that funder or a CEX deposit address, and return a cluster id with plain-language sybil risk reasons. Labeled exchange hot wallets are not used as a cluster. Optional peers compares up to 8 other wallets. Costs $0.02 USDC.

tools.name: wallet_quick
tools.description: Cheap copy-trade screen for one wallet: windowed realized PnL, win rate, closed trades, last active time, and bot, exchange, net-winner and dormant flags. Free teaser at /wallet/preview; full report at /wallet/profile. Costs $0.002 USDC.
